prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in earlier (after photo upload or adoption selection) and specific sign-in hints/copy won, whereas placing sign-in after the adoption certificate severely hurt conversion (-22.4%).
Adding focused individual screens (Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration, Pet Personality Intro, Visibility Check) won, while multi-step setup flows consistently degraded conversion.
Select layout redesigns won (Stage adoption, Story scroll/stage, Choose Path grid/carousel, Checklist intro), but photo upload layout redesigns and waiting screen spotlight severely hurt conversion (down to -23.3%).
Targeted notification prompts, desktop activity hints, and interaction hints won, while most audio cues, progress bars, tip carousels, and standalone headline updates showed no clear effect.
Predictions were overly pessimistic for major winning features, predicting negative or small gains (e.g., -8.0% or -0.2%) for changes that delivered up to +14.0% improvements.
Predictions were overly optimistic for non-winning changes, forecasting gains up to +12.0% on interventions that showed no clear effect or caused drops.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout Redesign for Pick Friend Screen: Redesigns the pet choice view on the Pick Friend screen into a horizontal carousel layout. (why: Adoption step has an 80.1% conversion rate and long completion time; carousel layouts worked effectively on Choose Path.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Redesign for Adoption Certificate Screen: Rebuilds the Adoption Certificate screen with a split layout pairing pet details on one side and official confirmation on the other. (why: Adoption drops by 19.9% before completion; visual layout updates give users a fresh, engaging confirmation view.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Cloud Retrieval Hint: Displays an explicit hint on the sign-in screen confirming that re-authenticating recovers existing pet profiles. (why: The single largest support category (8 emails) is users losing or missing pets after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Cloud Asset Preload Note: Adds reassuring status info on the waiting screen explaining background graphic assembly. (why: Home waiting step takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s; clear waiting notes reduce abandonments during load times.)
4: [finish, notification] Home Intro Companion Controls Notification Prompt: Prompts users on the home intro screen to enable desktop system notification shortcuts for quick pet commands. (why: Multiple support emails mention confusion around controlling and interacting with their pet after setup.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Desktop Experience Clarification: Refreshes the story screen headline and body copy to clearly set expectations for an interactive desktop companion. (why: Setting clear expectations right at the start reduces drop-offs later when desktop behaviors kick in.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Personalization Badge: Adds a stylized verified badge component onto the adoption certificate screen to celebrate pet creation. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (80.1%); visual badges increase sense of reward and completion intent.)
